items.title: WhatsApp’s ‘End-to-End Encryption by Default’ Claim Called Major Consumer Fraud by Pavel Durov
items.description: Telegram founder Pavel Durov has accused WhatsApp of perpetrating what he calls “the biggest consumer fraud in history,” alleging that the platform’s widely marketed end-to-end encryption (E2EE) claims are fundamentally misleading, leaving the private messages of billions of users exposed on unencrypted cloud servers. In a post published on April 9, 2026, Durov asserted that […] The post…
